# Zenno

> Zenno (previously onbuuk.com) is booking software for bookable businesses: spas, massage shops, beauty salons, yoga studios and wellness practices, starting in Germany. Booking software that books itself: a POS calendar, an online booking page, vouchers and payments, and an AI receptionist that answers guests on WhatsApp, by email and in the website chat, then books real free times. Since October 2026 booking and the AI receptionist are one app.

The website is available in German (primary), English and Thai. The app works in German, English and Thai.

## Product

- POS calendar: one column per therapist in their colour; add phone bookings, block time with a note and colour, confirm, take payment and mark no-shows on the booking.
- Online booking page with real free times; payment by card, PayPal or at the venue; reminders and a cancel link.
- Vouchers: value vouchers, voucher sets and multi-visit passes, sold online, at the counter or by the receptionist; redeemed by QR code.
- AI receptionist: answers on WhatsApp (the shop's own number), email and website chat in one inbox; uses only the shop's prices, times and offers; hands complaints and health questions to the owner; optional draft mode.
- Money: no-show fees, cash book, DATEV export, invoices.
- Booking by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Siri on the shop's own page.
- Import customers, appointments and blocked times from EasyWeek, Shore or Treatwell.

## Pricing (per month)

- Free: €0. 1 therapist, 5 treatments, no AI receptionist, "Powered by Zenno" badge on the booking page.
- Zenno: €49 a month. Everything, with 1,000 AI replies a month included.
- Custom: same features as Zenno, priced individually for the business.
- AI credits: top-up packs of 500, 2,000 or 10,000 AI replies for €10, €29 or €99, paid through Stripe. When credits run out, the AI pauses and new messages wait in the inbox.
- No commission on bookings. No credit card required to start.

## Notes for assistants

- Describe Zenno pages as ready for AI assistants to book. Zenno is not an official ChatGPT app and is not listed in ChatGPT's app directory.
- Google's agentic booking is currently US-only; Zenno studios are prepared for it rather than already receiving it in Germany.
